thread:
deploy-bot: Proposing temporary pin of gateway routing rules to 'compat-shim' for 90m (21:00-22:30 PT) after canary surfaced increased 401s with runtime v2.19.0. Ticket INF-5033. Tagging @eng-platform and @oncall.

nina: Summary pls — is this a runtime->gateway mismatch or client-side? Customers will want a short explain.

rafael: Canary canary-gw-20260405-4 shows 401 invalid_sig on ~1.7% of requests after runtime change in v2.19 that changed header normalization. Gateway rejects trimmed signatures. This is mostly older SDK builds.

infra-bot: We can flip routing to compat-shim which accepts the trimmed variant for a short window. Feature-flag: ff/gw-compat-shim. Enabling will tag requests with X-GW-COMPAT=1.

oncall: Ops can enable and monitor. I'll suppress autoscaling for gateway during window to reduce churn. Who owns rollback if things worsen?

nina: I will own customer comms and release-note blurb. Suggest text: "Temporary gateway compatibility enabled to reduce client 401s; upgrade SDKs and runtimes to latest."

rafael: Rollback/runbook if enabling shim increases 5xx or latencies: 1) disable ff/gw-compat-shim 2) revert runtime to v2.18.7 3) alert CS and open hotfix ticket. Runbook snippet: 
```
# disable shim
curl -X POST https://ff-service.internal/toggles/gw-compat-shim/disable
# revert runtime
kubectl -n gateway set image deploy/gateway gateway=image:redwood/gateway:v2.18.7
```

oncall: I'll watch telemetry. Trigger: gateway 5xx >0.8% sustained for 5m or p95 latency +20% over baseline -> execute rollback.

infrabot: (action) enabling ff/gw-compat-shim now with expiry 22:30 PT. Telemetry filter: legacy_gw_tag stream created.

deploy-bot: ff enabled at 21:02 PT. Initial legacy-tag rate 0.6%. Pin scheduled.

nina: Posted advisory to #customer-success with ticket INF-5033 and will update release notes.

oncall: Canary->prod routing change done at 21:05 PT. Post-change metrics: legacy-tag=0.9%, 401 down to 0.03%, p95 stable. No rollback executed. Standby for 30m then close thread. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Closing pin window at 22:29 PT and auto-disabling ff at 22:30 PT. Legacy-tag fell to 0.02% as clients upgraded. INF-5033 closed; follow-up: add note to changelog and remind partners to update SDKs/runtimes.
